verdict.rationale: Bolna documents Bring Your Own Telephony (BYOT), which connects any standards-compliant SIP trunk so you can use your own provider, numbers and rates instead of its built-in Twilio/Plivo telephony. Telephony providers can also be connected via Settings → Integrations, with no Bolna usage charge for connected providers. missing for 10: explicit evidence of importing Twilio/Telnyx numbers, configuration depth (PBX setup, codecs, auth/IP details), independent or hands-on corroboration.
